recentItems.title: China Sends Team of Tunnel Experts to Nepal to Support Complex Rescue Efforts
recentItems.description:
China has dispatched a team of nine tunnel experts to Nepal to support ongoing rescue efforts at a hydropower plant where several workers are thought to be trapped following August 26's devastating mudslide.

recentItems.title: Chinese Rescuers Battle Hazards to Clear Gyirong Highway in Xizang
recentItems.description:
Rescuers are battling natural obstacles to reopen the main corridor to Gyirong border port in southwest China’s Xizang Autonomous Region, after a deadly mudslide on August 26  cut off the land route.

recentItems.title: China-Kyrgyzstan Institute of Outstanding Engineers Inaugurated in Bishkek
recentItems.description:
The China-Kyrgyzstan Institute of Outstanding Engineers was inaugurated on August 30 at Kyrgyz State Technical University in Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, with the aim of providing local talent with academic education, scientific research opportunities, and hands-on industrial experience.

recentItems.title: Additional Military Personnel Join Mudslide Relief Operations in China's Xizang
recentItems.description:
Additional personnel from the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) and the People's Armed Police Force arrived in the mudslide-hit areas on Aug 30 to reinforce relief operations, days after a glacier collapse in Nepal triggered a massive mudslide that struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on the morning of Aug 26.
